name: Stock Overview
job: Render a visual operating dashboard with qualified four-week gross profit, revenue, food cost, margin, current production status, and direct workflow actions in dashboard mode, or full balances, demand, scanning, and stock evidence in stock mode.
incomingHandoff: A worker or manager needs a simple operating position or the detailed stock workspace.
outgoingHandoff: Dashboard mode routes to the next task; Stock mode exposes balances, shortages, scanning, recent evidence, and the physical count handoff.
responsiveBehaviour: Use 12-column summary and data territories at large layout, 8 columns at intermediate layout, and labelled stacked records on mobile without hiding units or differences.

layoutContract.containment: Dashboard mode gives one dominant financial evidence card with summary stats beneath its chart, then matching meal-direction, stock-readiness, recent-activity, and status-aware next-work panels. Stock mode contains lookup, readiness, balances, demand, activity, and reconciliation; wide records scroll inside their labelled region.

surfaceContract.contentSeparation: Content padding does not define primitive bounds.
surfaceContract.rule: No primitive surface is mounted until its semantic owner and edge behavior are chosen.

motionContract.justification: Stock truth must be immediately readable; only control feedback uses provider micro-interactions.
